name: nexql-mcp
description: Ask questions about your Postgres database in plain English. Read-only by default, with personal data masked.
long_description: NexQL connects Claude to a PostgreSQL database. It indexes the schema locally so Claude finds the right tables instead of guessing, runs read-only queries by default, and masks columns that look like personal data or secrets (emails, phone numbers, names, password hashes) before results reach the model. Use a least-privilege database role where you can, for example one granted pg_read_all_data.

database_url.title: Database URL
database_url.description: postgres://user:password@host:5432/dbname. After installing, ask Claude "what tables are in my database?" to check the connection.

allow_writes.title: Allow changes to data
allow_writes.description: Off (recommended): Claude can only read. On: Claude can also insert, update and delete rows.

schemas.title: Schemas
schemas.description: Optional. Comma-separated schemas Claude may see, e.g. public,sales. Leave empty for all schemas.
